images.alt_en: Illustration inspired by the story: At ten past six on the ninth evening before the Festival of Saint Aldric, with the light going copper along the river Orne, the bells in the crossing tower began to talk to themselves.
images.alt_sl: Ilustracija po zgodbi: Deset minut čez šesto, devetega večera pred praznikom svetega Aldrica, ko je svetloba ob reki Orne dobivala bakren odtenek, so se zvonovi v stolpu nad križiščem ladij začeli…
